description: This file declares an interface (ICompositionBuffer) for a frame buffer used in hardware-accelerated compositing, including nested structures for plane access and iteration, as well as associated enums and methods for handling buffer properties and lifecycle.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: Interface representing a hardware-optimized frame buffer with methods to access buffer properties, manage planes, and perform rendering.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a plane within the buffer, providing methods to access data and layout parameters.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing planes within the buffer.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the buffer object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the buffer object.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator to access the planes within the buffer.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Signals that the client is done with the planes.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the modifier describing the pixel arrangement for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (Invalid, DMA, or Raw).
